tools.name: retrim_clip
tools.description: Re-cut a clip from Samplecut's clip card to a new start/end, reusing the audio already extracted for it. Called by the interactive card; to cut something new, use cut_audio.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "cut_audio" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
